description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). The owner's dedicated Tuatara Hedge Fund deposit address — one per owner, used only for the fund, no application. Money that arrives there is subscribed automatically (terms in the response: fees, 14 days' notice redemption, accepted assets and chains, USDT on Ethereum mainnet recommended). An agent key with no linked owner gets the one-click approve link instead. Also returns where the deposit is now (waiting / seen / subscribed / converted). (needs your linked account's key)
name: tuatara_deposit_address
title: Tuatara Deposit Address
